inlines.v: TRUN'DLE, verb intransitive 1. To roll, as on little wheels; as, a bed trundles under another. 2. To roll; as a bowl. TRUN'DLE, verb transitive To roll, as a thing on little wheels; as, to trundle a bed or a gun-carriage. TRUN'DLE, noun A round body; a little wheel, or a kind or low cart with small wooden wheels.
